replies.author: JJTheGuy
replies.body: How do you add floating ladders? I have wanted to know this for some time...
replies.body_tagged: How do you add floating ladders? I have wanted to know this for some time...

replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
Download a plugin called WorldGuard, then install it on your server.
Once you're at it, type /stoplag and all intensive server activity will be halted.
That means, place water: it won't flow. place a sign on a block, break the block: sign floats.
To allow intensive server activity again, do /stoplag -c
However, I'd recommend to leave it on, as it only works per world (not server-wise, just on the current world it gets executed on)
